meta.guide_tau: Level caption:  energy (NIST, or a measurement of the last 20 years where one exists) and measured lifetime (where one exists).
meta.notes: Isotope shifts are nu(first) - nu(second); several sources print nu(138) - nu(A), signs were converted (138Ba lies lowest in frequency on 553.7, 791 and 413 nm). Level energies/wavelengths are NIST vacuum values; papers label the lines 553.7, 791.3 (vac) / 791.1 (air), 413.3, 659.7, 667.7, 1107.8, 1130.6, 1500.4 nm. method='compilation' means the number was read in a later paper/thesis table that names the original experiment (given in source); 'derived': true marks values computed here from printed numbers (3P1 A/B from F-level shifts; 791 nm frequency from an iodine offset). All lifetimes with method 'theory' are CI+MBPT calculations printed without uncertainty; lifetimes credited to Niggli & Huber 1987 are obtained from emission branching fractions combined with published lifetimes/absorption data (per their abstract), as tabulated in De's thesis. A_s values for lines NIST already lists (553.7, 1107.9, 1130.6, 791.4, 413.4, 659.7, 667.7 nm) are repeated only because the source gives an uncertainty or a newer measurement. Hyperfine sign convention: E_F = A*K/2 + B*[3K(K+1)/4 - I(I+1)J(J+1)]/[2I(2I-1)J(2J-1)], K = F(F+1)-I(I+1)-J(J+1). Extra keys beyond SCHEMA.md: 'ionization', 'conflicts', 'derived', 'note', 'F_shifts_from_centroid_MHz', 'hyperfine_component_shifts_MHz', 'photons_before_leak', 'abundance_unc', 'url_spin'.
